brief:
The United States has reached understandings with Israel and Syria regarding a clandestine nuclear facility, according to Axios. American officials said the installation, known as "Site 99" and dating to the Assad era, stored nuclear material potentially usable for a "dirty bomb."

Israel had previously threatened to strike the facility. The agreements represent an effort to neutralize the site and prevent proliferation risks stemming from the stored nuclear materials.
title: US secures agreements with Israel and Syria on secret nuclear site
